mainEntity.name: How long does it really take to launch an online business using AI?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A realistic first launch may take days or weeks, depending on how much research, product creation, platform setup, testing, and review are required. AI can shorten drafting and organizing work, but it cannot determine your offer-market fit or guarantee that checkout, delivery, email, and tracking work correctly.

Context: Run My AI Biz describes launch workflows covering sales pages, checkout, delivery, upsells, downsells, thank-you pages, and promotion. Every additional platform or integration adds testing and maintenance work.

Key factors:
- Whether the offer and audience are already clear.
- How much original content needs to be created.
- Whether accounts, payment tools, email systems, and delivery pages are ready.
- How many review rounds are needed.

Practical guidance: Set a small launch scope, create a checklist, and test the complete customer path before announcing it. Keep extra automation for later unless it removes a clearly identified bottleneck.

Run My AI Biz emphasizes practical preparation rather than promising a fixed launch deadline.
acceptedAnswer.description: There is no dependable one-day timeline. A small launch can take days or weeks depending on the offer, content, platform setup, integrations, testing, and revisions. AI speeds up drafts, but the customer path still needs careful checking.
